verdict.rationale: Viam documents first-party fleet primitives relevant to this story. The fleet management API creates and manages fragments, organizations, locations and machines, and manages the fleet in code as in the web UI. Viam also advertises OTA updates for software and ML models, plus canary testing and rollbacks. Together these imply staged, grouped rollout, but no evidence shows fragments propagating one config change to many machines at once, or targeting a specific group. Missing for 10: explicit docs that a fragment or config change propagates across multiple machines simultaneously, documented per-group targeting (e.g., by location or tag) for config pushes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet-wide config rollout.
